entries.title: OpenAI Agents SDK multi-agent orchestration
entries.relationship: Representative orchestration surface; potential future trace adapter.
entries.decision: Track adapter requirements after the core report stabilizes.

entries.title: Anthropic multi-agent research system engineering report
entries.relationship: Documents coordination, evaluation, and reliability challenges in one deployed multi-agent system.
entries.decision: Use as an engineering signal, not general scientific evidence.

entries.title: NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit documentation
entries.relationship: Potential future trace and observability adapter; no core dependency.
entries.decision: Defer evaluation to platform stage; install nothing in M0/M1.

entries.title: GitHub Octoverse 2025
entries.relationship: Provides project and repository adoption context, not organization TAM.
entries.decision: Retain as a contextual signal with unit and double-counting warnings.

entries.title: OpenAI State of Enterprise AI 2025
entries.relationship: Vendor-specific business adoption signal used as a transparent scenario anchor.
entries.decision: Do not describe the vendor customer count as global market size.

entries.title: Gartner enterprise application agent forecast
entries.relationship: Context for uncertainty about adoption velocity; not an input to computed TAM/SAM.
entries.decision: Keep forecast separate from observed facts and model calculations.
